since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-04-11T00:00:00Z). Authors with a postMeta.createdAt >= this are returned. Omit/blank for all-time authors.

main.description: Returns the distinct DIDs that have posted Zeens content (have an app.zeens.postMeta record) since an optional `since` timestamp. Powers the 'posted recently' half of the admin Active Users tab in one bulk query instead of a per-user getAuthorFeed.
